messages:
Priya K: FYI - OrionHealth legal reached out. They want to POC a customer-tuned Mirage-34B variant on Dedicated. Need a quick compatibility scan (int8 quant path), KMS plan, and rough monthly pricing. POC window: 2 weeks starting Apr 6. tagging @Evan S for infra, @Lina M for security, @Marcus P for pricing.

Evan S: On infra — can you paste the model artifacts size + seq-len distribution? int8 quant might save GPU mem but we need to check KV cache behavior.

Priya K: artifacts: model.tar.gz 28GB (fp16), tokenizer+config 120MB. Typical seq distribution: 90% <=512, 10% up to 2048. They enable long-context for summarization but mostly 512.

Lina M: security — we need the data flow and KMS requirement. Are they bringing their own KMS? Also check checklist on PI/PHI handling.

Priya K: customer insists on BYOK via AWS KMS and audit logs retention 13 months. They want on-prem option if needed.

Marcus P: Pricing quick ballpark for Dedicated POC: For a 2-week reserved slot + burst capacity — better to propose reserved + pay-as-you-go for excess. I'll draft numbers; need expected RPS and concurrency.

Evan S: Concurrency: expected 6 concurrent streams, avg response ~450 tokens. With batching + KV cache we can meet latency SLO. Need to confirm GPU type — A100-80G or H100? 34B fp16 on A100 with int8 might fit on 80G but H100 preferred.

Priya K: Customer prefers H100 if available. They asked about model variants: they trained a 34B-quant-pt checkpoint that uses a fused attention op — may require a custom kernel. Is that supported?

Evan S: If it's a fused custom op we need to validate during onboarding; may require a kernel shim or rebuild. Ask customer for a minimal reproducible inference script (example run with their checkpoint).

Lina M: Also send them our security questionnaire short answers; flag that PHI may require Private deployment + SOC2 + contract addendum.

Marcus P: For the POC, I'm OK with a discounted trial: 50% off Dedicated for the first month if we get commit to enterprise plan. I'll draft proposal once infra confirms GPU and throughput.

Priya K: Action items: @Evan S - run compatibility probe with their sample inference script by EOD Thu. @Lina M - prep security Q&A + list of audit/KMS clauses. @Marcus P - draft POC pricing + terms. I'll coordinate with customer and push artifacts. :thumbsup:

solutions-bot: Deploy job queued: compatibility-probe/mirage-34b-1766661000 -> status queued.

Evan S: Got sample script from customer at 12:18 — dropping it in /tmp/mirage_probe.tar.gz. Kicked off dry-run; logs show missing op 'fused_self_attn_v2' at 12:32. Need compiled kernel from vendor or fallback to non-fused path.

Priya K: Customer replies they can export model without fused ops within 24h. If not, they can share compiled kernel but legal wants IP review.

Lina M: If they share compiled kernel we need to run legal/security approval; could delay POC by ~3 business days. Flagging as enterprise blocker.

Marcus P: Noted. Pricing hold if kernel sharing required beyond standard onboarding. I will add an SLA clause about time-to-onboard and additional engineering costs.

Priya K: thanks team. I'll update customer and set next sync Thu 3pm PT. If kernel issue resolved earlier we can accelerate. End.
